nom: PURITO From Green Cleansing Oil for Sensitive Skin, 6.76 fl.oz

avis.titre: Best natural oil cleanser I've tried
avis.texte: I wear mineral sunscreen religiously, and need a good oil cleanser to help me take it off every evening before bed. What I DON'T need is a bunch of petroleum based ingredients, added fragrance (synthetic or natural), or any other questionable ingredient. Imagine my surprise when I realized that is actually a tall order. Burt's bees = Works. But it's loaded with fragrance, and no matter how thorough a job I think I have done rinsing it off, some always seems to find its way into my eyes, and they sting a tiny bit every time I use it. It also legitimately hurts if I am having a mild eczema flare. Elizavecca = Eureka (or so so I thought!) But it's got BHT, so it's not perfect. It's also weirdly hard to find (I was hitting up Jolse and waiting weeks in shipping time). Enter Purito: I bought it, I love(d) it, and I have been wondering ever since why it has taken me so long to try. I'm a big fan of their other products, especially since they have started phasing out the essential oils and fragrances out of many of them (fragrance in general is sensitizing, but for someone with recurrent eczema, skin products with EOs/fragrance can turn into a nightmare real fast). This stuff dissolves my sunscreen flawlessly and quickly. The texture is liquid, but not overly runny like Burts Bees and Elizavecca. It works for my dry skin, but feels pretty neutral and seems like it would be fine for other skin types as well. It doesn't smell like anything and most importantly of all, keeps my skin ha

avis.titre: Works pretty well as makeup remover, softens skin
avis.texte: I bought this mostly as a makeup remover to take off my waterproof eyeliner and mascara. Keep in mind that it maybe isn’t meant for eyes, so I might be an idiot 🤪. It worked great on the eyeliner, but the mascara was a bit more stubborn. (FYI, Heroine Make Long and Curl waterproof mascara is fantastic, but it is nearly impossible to wash off.) It was more successful at removing Peripera Ink Black Cara waterproof mascara. I had to really massage in this Purito oil cleanser to get the mascara off, which kinda sucks because it’s not really good to tug on eyelid skin. However, this stuff doesn’t have parabens or other chemicals like other oil makeup removers I’ve tried, so I really like that. Easily removed concealer, powder, eyebrow pencil, etc. Ok, so here is the good part: it is GREAT for cleansing skin. And I have combo/oily aging skin, so I wasn’t expecting that. I was worried it would make me break out, so the first time I tried it I did a second wash after with a micellar foaming cleanser. Turns out it wasn’t necessary because even when I didn’t do the second wash, I didn’t break out. My skin is noticeably softer after using this stuff, both with the second micellar cleanser wash and without (just Purito.) I think maybe I was over-stripping my skin before? Over drying with foaming cleansers? I think this stuff keeps my skin moisturized even while cleansing. I woke up a little shinier than usual, but I think that is preferable to over-drying, which actually sometimes cause

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS CLEANSER! I cannot say enough about the product!! I am a tried-and-true skincare reviewer, and I always go back to this cleanser. I have done my fair share of research on this product. It is non-comedogenic and made from simple ingredients that don't irritate the skin. I have purchased this several times, and this is the only oil cleanser I use. I get great value from the products, as each bottle lasts me around 3 months, and usually, this product has a great price for a long-lasting product. There is no fragrance, and it is a lightweight oil that helps remove dead skin cells and impurities from my skin. This always provides me with a great cleanse and leaves my pores feeling clean and clear. If you haven't tried this product and are in the market for an acne-safe cleanser that promotes skin health and cleanliness, then this is the product for you!

avis.titre: Highly effective and budget-friendly oil cleanser
avis.texte: Basic, effective, wallet-friendly cleansing oil for my oil-based cleanser needs. The texture isn’t too thick nor too thin, and spreads out easily over your face when first massaging it in. It emulsifies well, and my skin afterwards feels soft and clean without being dry. It doesn’t leave a weird film on your face either. I don’t wear too much makeup, but it has taken off my sunscreen and any other residual makeup I might have worn without any extra effort on my part. The price on this, for the amount, is so reasonable that I would absolutely buy this again.

i’ve been using this one to double cleanse for a few years now. I have tried to switch to other brands just for the heck of trying something new and I have always come back to this. it does a great job of removing all of my make up at the end of the day. It feels very moisturizing. It lasts a long time and I feel like it’s such a necessary step in my skin care routine in order to get my skin feeling clean and hydrated.

avis.titre: The best mineral sunscreen remover I have ever used!
avis.texte: I've been struggling to find something that removes mineral sunscreen. After reading a review I decided to give this a try. Works WAY better than expensive removers and doesn't irritate my skin. I was having to use harsh soaps to get the sunscreen off, washing multiple times and my skin would be so red and angry. This stuff is amazing! I rub it in and leave for a minute or so while the shower heats up and it rinses right off and does not leave an oily residue! LOVE IT!
Barely feel a difference in my face, but it ends up looking lighter. Love the bottle size related to the price.

avis.titre: Holly Grail for sensitive skin 💖✨Holly Grail for sensitive skin 💖✨
avis.texte: Was hesitant but now I absolutely love it. Melts away make up so easily and does not leave you dry after. Yes even melts away waterproof mascara. I will definitely order this one again. No harsh ingredients, no harsh smell. Still great for the price given you will only need like 3 pumps. I noticed my skin feeling better after cleansing with this oil rather then using my cutton pads soaked in make up remover that yearly adds up costing way more. Consistent application. Lasts long. Love it.
Muy buena relación calidad-precio. Emulsiona bien con agua y retira eficazmente el maquillaje con suavidad.

avis.titre: Excellente huile nettoyante, efficace et très agréable à utiliser
avis.texte: J’utilise cette huile nettoyante PURITO depuis environ 1 an et c’est clairement l’une des meilleures que j’ai testées. Elle est douce, agréable à masser et très efficace pour bien nettoyer la peau. Je l’applique sur peau sèche, je masse environ 30 secondes, puis j’ajoute un peu d’eau pour l’émulsionner. La texture devient laiteuse et on sent qu’elle aide vraiment à décoller les impuretés, le sébum et les résidus accumulés dans les pores. Je l’utilise dans une routine de double nettoyage, avant de compléter avec un gel nettoyant. Elle se rince bien et ne laisse pas de sensation grasse sur la peau. Même si l’odeur n’est pas très agréable au début, on s’y habitue assez vite. Très bon produit, efficace et économique grâce au grand format. Je continuerai à le racheter.

I love this product! I was hesitant to purchase it because it is a little bit pricey for my income, but after a week of using I am already seeing results. No skin irritation like other cleaners. It thoroughly cleanses my skin without stripping my skin barrier. The scent is not desirable though but it’s okay as long as the quality is perfect!I will definitely buy again in the future!

It’s not bad for an oil cleanser! It does make my face feel clean, but doesn’t fully melt my eyeliner. I’ve tried other Korean oil cleansers that remove my eyeliner completely. It has a slightly weird smell in my opinion, but nothing too serious. It’s not too oily which is nice and feels very soft. Wanted to get this to use with the rest of the products from purito
Absolutely love this product! It’s great for very sensitive skin like mine!

I got this product delivered to me to replace my Clinique cleansing balm. I loved it but it's just expensive so I wanted to try another oil based cleanser that was more affordable and came across purito. I like their other products and have repurchased their deep water cream moisturizer, so I am hopeful that this will work just as well, if not better. The packing was strange, as shown in the picture when I opened up the Amazon packaging it came opened with the pump on the outside? Not sure why it would come opened?? But I checked that it was still sealed for the integrity of the product and it looks as if it has not been used. I am glad this comes with both the pump and the cap, that way you can switch between the 2 options in case you need to go somewhere, very travel friendly! I will edit after I try it for a couple weeks, hopefully there will be good results :))
The pump came broken. It just seemed like a hassle to return it and get another one.
I bought this face wash thinking it would be okay for my sensitive skin. Guess not! My skin is burning now along with puffy and red.
It does the work (it cleanses the face fast). Unfortunately, it gave me little tiny pimples on my forehead. Have to return it, sadly 😥 😔 😟.

i used this product because i heard it was great for removing makeup. i usually have beautiful clear skin but this really made my face break out. i stopped using it after a week.
